changelog:
- Enhanced Article Video Playback: Resolved CNN Business and news media video player stalls by whitelisting WarnerMedia/Turner/Freewheel streaming delivery infrastructure, enabling seamless third-party cookies for media authentication, allowing mixed content streaming chunks, and auto-granting protected media playback.
- Glitch-Free Pull-to-Refresh: Re-engineered SwipeRefreshLayout with dynamic on-scroll child detection, preventing touch interception and scrolling jank while reading mid-page, and smoothly activating pull-down refresh strictly when at the top of the webpage.
- Find in Page: Added floating in-page text search bar with real-time match counter, up/down match navigation, and back-press dismissal.
- Quick Copy Link: Added 1-tap Copy Link item in Daily Essentials to easily share current page URLs.
